name: Camp Woods and Wildlife
what_you_do: Spend a week at a forest camp. Take outdoor classes on forests, wildlife, how to name trees and forest care. Try a lumberjack field day, canoeing and archery.
who_can_apply: Virginia residents ages 13 to 16 on the first day of camp. You like nature, have good grades and have not been before. An adult who is not family must nominate you.
pay_detail: Selected students get a $300 scholarship and pay a $95 registration fee.
deadline_text: 2026 camp was June 15 to 19, 2026. The page says 2027 information and the application will be posted in February. Applicants are told starting in March.
how_to_apply: Student fills in the first three sections of the application and nomination form. The nominating adult (teacher, forester, youth leader) fills in the fourth. Submit both together by mail, email or fax.
notes: Camp has run for more than 70 years. It was formerly called Holiday Lake Forestry Camp. Scholarships come from forest industry and conservation sponsors.
